title: Security: one shared SSH key is the live VM's whole perimeter (trainer + 62 workflows), no host-key pinning
note: MEASURED 2026-11-11 (live ssh.service journal via diag, ~23h retained): 10,222 accepted logins, all user ubuntu, all ONE key fingerprint; of the newest 2,000, 1,935 came from the trainer VM and 65 from 31 other public sources (Actions runners). 1,976 failed attempts from 31 sources in 23h (per hour: median 50, max 588, n=25). The ssh journal starts 2026-11-10 22:50Z, so under 24h of login history is kept. REPO READ: VM_SSH_KEY is referenced by 62 of 166 workflows; 0 of 60 SSH workflows pin a known_hosts entry (53 use accept-new). INFERRED: ubuntu has passwordless sudo (the deploy script uses sudo -n cp/chmod/systemctl). UNVERIFIED: sshd_config, fail2ban, OCI security list. Proposed: separate keys for the trainer and for Actions; from= on the trainer key; a pinned host key as a secret; longer journal retention for ssh. Until the keys are split a new-source login alert cannot work. Tier 2, key origination is the operator's.
